title: Pan-Seared Grapes with Light Crust
description: A simple dessert recipe featuring sweet grapes in a crispy light crust. Perfect for a light snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: light norwegian crust mix
ingredients.notes: Pre-made mix for a light, crispy crust

instructions: In a bowl, mix together crust mix and water until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thin sheet.
Place the grapes on one half of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the grapes and press the edges to seal.
Use a knife or pastry brush to create a decorative edge.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
